I/O append helpers for raw, dead, move, part, and in-place LZ4 pair records.

# Purpose
`fd_vinyl_io.c` implements write-side helper functions for the `fd_vinyl_io_t` interface. It provides a finalizer wrapper, scratch-pad size estimation, and several append routines that format and submit vinyl bstream records. The file handles raw key/value pairs, dead records, move records, and part records. Each append function allocates space from the I/O object, fills the proper block or pair header fields, copies any payload data, computes the block hash with the I/O seed, and then appends the result.

The file also contains [`fd_vinyl_io_append_pair_inplace`](<#fd_vinyl_io_append_pair_inplace>), which can append a pair either as raw data or as LZ4-compressed data. It checks the value size, decides whether compression is useful, and uses temporary scratch space for the compressed form when needed. If compression does not reduce the encoded size, it falls back to the raw pair. This file is part of the vinyl storage write path and defines internal helper logic for building and appending encoded records, not a public executable entry point.
